description: SQL-CONTINUE, deciding variants: the position of the blocked candidate and the flag. Eight tables Cb<position><mode> (position m = ID 2 blocked, f = ID 1, l = ID 3, a = all three; mode n = no flag, f = dbFailOnError) each hold (ID, V) = (1,10), (2,20), (3,30); a second Workspace holds a pessimistic Edit on the blocked rows; each table gets UPDATE SET V = V + 1 after a failing marker, so Errors read afterwards shows whether a successful Execute keeps or clears a prior error; the return, RecordsAffected, Errors and every table's rows are captured. Follow-up probe (status F) for SQL-CONTINUE, SQL-ACT-FAIL; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
